rows.label: tlk70000030_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I...have to stay here. This city
is the only home I have left.

rows.label: tlk70000030_04_msg0003
rows.name:
The restaurant is just
scraping by, but I still
have a few regular customers.

rows.label: tlk70000030_04_msg0004
rows.name:
They barge into the restaurant without
caring how depressed I am. Honestly,
they're a real nuisance.

rows.label: tlk70000030_04_msg0005
rows.name:
But thanks to that, I feel just a
little... just a little more positive.

rows.label: tlk70000030_04_msg0006
rows.name:
So I feel like one more little push
might be enough for me to recover...

rows.label: tlk70000030_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Sorry for hinting at something when
you're just about to leave...

rows.label: tlk70000030_04_msg0008
rows.name:
Adel-sama, Laura-sama, everyone...
Please come back safely.
